description: Semantic role map for TREC 11-8. Coordinates extracted directly from the live AcroForm widget rects (pdf-lib), same method as api/_assets/trec-20-19-esign-coords.json. Roles/keys/checkbox-meanings derived from viewing the rendered numbered overlay (.tmp/coord-overlays/backup-contract-page*.png) against the real printed form text — NOT from the raw AcroForm field names, which are frequently misleading or duplicated (see individual field notes). x_pct/y_pct/w_pct/h_pct are top-left-origin fractions of the page (0-1 is NOT used here — these are percentages 0-100, matching scripts/extract-trec-field-coords.js convention; divide by 100 before feeding into DocuSeal areas[] which expects 0-1 fractions). CORRECTION 2026-09-08: 4 page-1 footer initial widgets reassigned from deal-text to party initials (see field notes).
